# m-sampling changelog

## 2.0.0 (components 2.6.0)

- Seeded sampling with or without replacement: named balls/proportions or numbered cards/means; four deterministic steps.
- Stacked dot plot, population marker, latest sample, Japanese/English text and accessible final summary.
- Report invalid input and insufficient space; clamp sample size and repetition limits, preserve author labels, hide answer preview.
- Space stacked text by font boxes; use nice mean ticks, omit card composition, and reserve plot height for dots of at least 5px radius.
